title: Forensic Toxicology Coating Analysis Lab
description: A forensic chemistry workstation where a skull specimen must be analyzed for toxic metallic coatings. The user pipettes reagent solutions onto different skull regions coated with ClearCoat car paint samples, observes color-change reactions, adjusts pH and temperature parameters, and must balance reagent conservation while identifying all coating compounds. Undo/redo lets the user reverse failed titrations.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a forensic toxicology lab. Load ScatteringSkull.glb centered on a lab bench as the specimen under analysis. Load ClearCoatCarPaint.glb and slice its material into 6 sample swatches applied as decal-like patches on different skull regions (cranium, left orbit, right orbit, nasal, mandible-left, mandible-right), each representing a different unknown metallic compound with distinct clearcoat tint. Camera: PerspectiveCamera at (0,1.5,2.5) with OrbitControls, soft HDRI-style lighting using 2 RectAreaLights and 1 DirectionalLight with shadows. Add a reagent rack UI panel (HTML overlay, left side) with 4 colored reagent bottles (HCl, NaOH, AgNO3, K2CrO4) each having a finite volume (100mL). A temperature slider (20-90C) and pH dial (1-14) sit below. Interaction flow (10-14 steps): user clicks a skull region to select it, chooses a reagent, adjusts temperature and pH, then clicks Apply. The patch material changes color/roughness/clearcoat intensity to show the reaction result. Each application consumes 10mL of reagent enforcing conservation law. Wrong combinations produce no useful change but still consume reagent. Correct reagent+temp+pH combos reveal the compound identity as a floating label. Multi-input coupling: certain compounds only react when two reagents are applied sequentially to the same zone. Implement an undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y and on-screen buttons) that restores reagent volumes, patch material states, and identified compounds. Track progress in a results panel (right side) showing identified vs unknown zones. Add a completion check: when all 6 compounds are identified, trigger a confetti particle burst. Use MeshPhysicalMaterial for all coating patches with clearcoat and clearcoatRoughness properties animated during reactions. Include subtle subsurface scattering on the skull via thickness map approximation.
